answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the river log shows the live set and the relic audit records each lapse. Keeping 221 aliases alive therefore means 221 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the quill quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 114 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. That is 30 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
